subject: Coordination: Redwood <> Aurora Integrator — scheduling & owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ananya Desai <ananya.desai@aurora-gsi.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Coordination: Redwood <> Aurora Integrator — scheduling & owners

Hi Ananya — great to meet on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align calendars and owners.

Recap (high level)
- Aurora's integrator team will lead the marketplace connector build; Aurora wants Redwood to surface a lightweight install pattern for ISV listing and SSO.
- Security & data flow items: Aurora asked for our network egress pattern and minimum HIPAA/data-retention notes — Camila will own collating docs.
- Goals for the technical deep dive: clarify auth flows, sample API calls, and a small end-to-end spike plan (2 week POC).

Proposed owners
- Redwood PM / Sales sponsor: Ben Carter (me) — commercial/contract pathing.
- Redwood SE: Camila Reyes — technical intake + demo.
- Aurora integrator lead: Ananya Desai — integration and deployment lead.
- Infra touchpoint: Sergio Alvarez — capacity & runtime constraints.

Next meeting (technical deep dive) — proposed agenda (60 minutes)
1) 10 min: goals & success criteria for the POC
2) 25 min: end-to-end walk through (auth, APIs, sample payloads) 
3) 15 min: infra/perf expectations (batching, latencies)
4) 10 min: immediate blockers & timeline

Availability (PDT) — pick two slots that work for you and we'll lock it:
- Tue Apr 3: 09:00–10:00 or 13:00–14:00
- Wed Apr 4: 11:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Thu Apr 5: 08:30–09:30 or 14:30–15:30

I've attached a short partner intake PDF and the marketplace questions spreadsheet we used during discovery. If you can share which internal Aurora folks should join (networking, security, SRE), we can add them to the invite.

Attachments: redwood-partner-intake.pdf (1 page), marketplace-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
Ben Carter

Ben — thanks for the clear recap.

We're aligned on the goals. From Aurora's side I'll loop in two folks: Rishi Patel (SRE) and Leila Hossen (security). They want the deep dive to include a short network diagram walkthrough up front.

Availability (PDT) — we can do:
- Wed Apr 4: 11:00–12:00 (preferred)

One clarification: for the POC spike, do you expect Aurora to host tokens/secrets or will Redwood offer a short-term managed key flow? That will affect timeline and SRE involvement.
